title: Long distance dates that actually feel like a date

slides.title: Long distance dates that *actually feel like a date*
slides.sub: For when “so… how was your day?” isn’t cutting it anymore.

slides.title: Cook *the same recipe.*
slides.body: Pick one dish, shop separately, cook it together on video.

slides.title: Movie night, *in sync.*
slides.body: Press play at the same second. Text your reactions.

slides.title: Take a walk *together.*
slides.body: Call while you both walk your neighborhood. Show each other around.

slides.title: Send a *surprise delivery.*
slides.body: Their favorite snack, at their door, on a random Tuesday.

slides.title: Play a game *online.*
slides.body: Trivia, chess or a co-op game. The loser plans the next date.

slides.title: Write *actual letters.*
slides.body: On paper, in the post. It’ll arrive like a hug.

slides.title: Save this *for your next date apart.*
slides.sub: Then send it to the person on the other end of the call.
